record.question: Whose country's Prime Minister has been conferred with prestigious 'Vaccine Hero' award of Global Alliance for Vaccination and Immunizations (GAVI) at the UN General Assembly (UNGA)?
record.explanation: Answer B: Bangladesh. Gavi’s own 23 September 2019 release says Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina received the Vaccine Hero Award at a UN General Assembly side event. Reference: https://www.gavi.org/news/media-room/prime-minister-bangladesh-receives-2019-vaccine-hero-award. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
